introduction: This level targets specialized scientific, medical, and environmental institutes. Examiners love these because they represent India's modern technological and health-defense infrastructure.

core_concepts.title: National Institute of Virology (NIV)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Pune, Maharashtra**. 
Key Fact: Operating under the ICMR, it became highly famous during the COVID-19 pandemic as the apex lab for virus research in India.

core_concepts.title: Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**. 
Key Fact: A premier institute under CSIR that focuses on biomedical research and the development of new drugs/medicines.

core_concepts.title: National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Nagpur, Maharashtra**. 
Key Fact: It tackles problems related to water supply, sewage disposal, and communicable diseases. It falls under the CSIR umbrella.

core_concepts.title: Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI)
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Mysore, Karnataka**. 
Key Fact: It conducts research on food processing, preservation, and technology to prevent post-harvest losses.

important_entities.name: High Altitude Research Laboratory
important_entities.significance: Located at a massive altitude, it is primarily used for cosmic ray research and atmospheric studies.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Exam Trick: 
- Central **Drug** Research Institute is in **Lucknow**. 
- Central **Toxicology** Research Institute (Indian Institute of Toxicology Research) is *also* in **Lucknow**! (Both the medicine and the poison are studied in the same city).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: NEERI (National Environmental Engineering Research Institute) starts with N and is located in **Nagpur** (starts with N).

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated Bank PO and State PCS question: 'Where is the National Institute of Virology situated?' Answer: Pune.
